name: Ano Hi, Bokura wa Himitsu o Umeta
original_name: あの日、ぼくらは秘密を埋めた
source:
A canon-divergent Vicdrew (Andrew/Victor) centric visual novel about dreams and burying bodies in the forest.
As Andrew stays at the "old house," Victor becomes his trusted courier, and from there on, a relationship blossoms.

[Taken from the [url=https://himiume.carrd.co/]official website[/url]]

Identity V fangame.
translation:
一部与经典不同的Vicdrew（安德鲁/维克多）以视觉小说为中心的视觉小说，讲述梦想和在森林中埋葬尸体。
当安德鲁住在“老房子”时，维克多成为他值得信赖的信使，从那时起，两人的关系蓬勃发展。

[摘自[url=https://himiume.carrd.co/]官网[/url]]

第五人格同人游戏。
